content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stock photos

The inability to access platforms like PayPal and Stripe restricts many creators from selling digital products, including stock photos. This situation stems from various factors, such as regional regulations and operational limitations imposed by these companies. For creators in excluded countries, the stakes are high: losing access to funds or facing account suspensions can jeopardize their livelihood. Thus, an alternative architecture is essential, one that not only bypasses these restrictions but also establishes an enduring framework for secure and efficient transactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling stock photos without PayPal involves a combination of reliable and cost-effective tools. By utilizing platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transaction processing, creators can build a resilient online store. This architecture ensures that payments are processed with minimal fees while providing immediate access to funds. Moreover, leveraging services like Supabase for order management enhances data control, ensuring creators retain ownership of their sales and customer information.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable. It serves photographers, designers, and other artists who wish to sell stock photos without the risk of payment suspensions or account closures. By employing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators are empowered to operate independently, avoiding the pitfalls associated with centralized platforms that may restrict their access based on geography. Ultimately, this model fosters a more equitable digital marketplace.
Empower your sales with full control over your digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of this commerce infrastructure hinges on several key components. Cloudflare Pages facilitates fast and secure hosting, while Google Apps Script allows for custom backend processing logic. Supabase provides a robust database solution for managing orders and customer data, and NOWPayments enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions without the need for cumbersome KYC processes. Together, these elements create a cohesive ecosystem that supports the selling of stock photos and other digital products, ensuring that creators maintain full control over their operations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select a domain and set up your Cloudflare Pages account. Next, utilize Google Apps Script to create your backend logic, integrating it with NOWPayments for payment processing. Load your digital products into Supabase, ensuring that each item is properly linked to your payment system. Finally, configure your store for optimal performance, including necessary security measures like SPF/DKIM/DMARC. For those seeking a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a ready-made deployment in just 48 hours.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the pitfalls of account suspensions and payment restrictions.

Explore options like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy a robust online store quickly. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
